about_short_description.short_description: RevenueCat is a subscription management platform for apps that monetize through in-app purchases.

product.name: Subscription Management Platform
product.description: A platform that manages in-app purchases and subscriptions across iOS, Android, and web using a unified API and backend service.

product.name: Paywall Builder
product.description: A tool to create, customize, and deploy in-app paywalls with a visual editor and remote configuration.

product.name: Targeting and Segmentation
product.description: A feature to tailor paywalls, pricing, and packaging by audience segments and in-app placement.

product.name: A/B Testing and Experimentation
product.description: A system for remotely configurable A/B tests and analytics to evaluate subscription growth strategies.

product.name: Unified Subscription Data and Analytics
product.description: A dashboard and API providing normalized, cross-platform subscription and revenue data with key performance indicators.

product.name: Customer Management and Support Tools
product.description: Tools to view and manage individual customer subscription status and resolve purchase-related issues.
